message: No detected input validation: The code uses argparse with type coercion and limited choices constraints, but there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the actual incoming dataset data itself during data acquisition.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data from a local directory path (--dataset-dir) and there is no evidence of fetching from remote sources, nor any checksum verification, signed URL, or authentication mechanism.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models dynamically via importlib and argparse arguments but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks on pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No imports or usage of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential privacy mechanism are present.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are referenced or implemented anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the logger and early stopping callbacks only track training and validation metrics without any tampering safeguards.

No detected input sanitization: The code shown is focused on training (argument parsing, early stopping, logging); no inference path with input validation, shape checks, or schema validation is visible.
No detected output bounds checks: No inference output handling code is present in the snippet; there are no probability bounds checks, NaN guards, or threshold validations.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model appears to be a text classification/NLP model, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation is present anywhere in the code.
